analysis: Examined ProviderLoop+InferenceHandler.swift head (lines 1-1145). Changes visible: new optional workFIFOGate parameter (line 194); decode refactor to Self.decodeInboundChatRequest returning request plus extensions (lines 349-365, 398, 407, 410); and a conditional releaseWorkFIFO(workFIFOGate, requestId:) after acceptance and registration when the model is cold and not mimo_v2 (lines 556-558). Security-relevant behavior retained: ciphertext decrypted with keyPair; sender key length checked; reserved tool-schema metadata rejected unless the authenticated protocol version matches (321-328); cache scope is coordinator-authored via remoteCache.scope and not caller prompt_cache_key/user (T-041 scope isolation intact, line 403); decode error logs only a generic message, with no prompt fragments; per-chunk encryption fails closed with a 502 encryptionFailure terminal (T-008, lines 811-831); drain/shutdown/deadline gating and the receipt finalizer still settle on all early exits. The refactor now reads templateControls, logprobsSpec and samplingOverrides from inbound.extensions, produced by the new decodeInboundChatRequest. That function is not in the supplied units, so I could not verify it keeps identical extraction semantics (e.g., same-parse extraction when repairs alter the body, no leakage of plaintext in errors, rejection of reserved metadata). Also unverified are the WorkFIFOGate/releaseWorkFIFO implementation (ordering/availability: early release lets later events proceed while a cold load is pending; the cancel/early-exit paths in this file do not obviously double-release, and idempotence is not checked) and the remaining part of the patch beyond line 1145 of the file. No concrete regression is identified from the supplied evidence. Integration should examine ProviderLoop+InboundDecode.swift and the WorkFIFOGate definition.
